learning_outcomes.text: Understanding and interpreting texts and data, developing skills to specify them and present them clearly and concisely.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and time and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to transmit concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering orally and in writing, clearly and correctly.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for finding sustainable engineering solutions.
Ability for teamwork and ability to develop multidisciplinary projects.
Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION. Generalities. Implementation. Definition of necessary buildings. The project. Execution of a work. Programming. The terrain. Layout. Earthmoving. Definition of construction. Project conditions. Actions in building. Structural analysis. Annex to Theme I. Binders, mortars and concretes. Elementary methods for dimensioning reinforced concrete sections. Detail of the strut-and-tie method. Anchorage of passive reinforcement. Splicing of passive reinforcement. Preparation of rebar and placement of passive reinforcement.

FOUNDATIONS. Introduction. Types of foundations. Bearing capacity of the ground. Definition of foundations. Rigid continuous footings with centered load. Rigid continuous footings with eccentric load or moment. Rigid pile caps. Flexible foundations. Flexible continuous footings with centered load. Flexible continuous footings with eccentric load or moment. Isolated footings. Symmetrical isolated footings with centered vertical load. Symmetrical isolated footings with eccentric vertical load or moment. Flexible isolated footings. Party wall footings. Corner footings. Anchor plates for metal columns. Dimensions of bearing plates. Dimension of anchor bolts.
WALLS AND FLOOR SLABS. Introduction. Facade materials. Ordinary masonry walls. Ceramic brick walls. Calculation of brick walls. Block walls. Calculation of block walls. Metal facades.
ROOFS. Generalities. Roof materials. Roof schemes. Roofs with slate and tile plates. Fiber cement roofs. Roofs with metal plates. Roof purlins.

INDUSTRIAL BUILDINGS. STATIC COMPOSITION. Introduction. Trusses. Supports or columns. Rail beams and lintel beams. Gable walls. Stability. Attached industrial buildings. Construction details of small industrial buildings.
INDUSTRIAL BUILDINGS. HYPERSTATIC COMPOSITION. Simple portals. Lattice portals. Solid web portals. Multiple portals. Simplified calculation expressions.

SPECIAL CONSTRUCTIONS FOR INDUSTRIAL BUILDINGS. Sawtooth industrial buildings. Asymmetric industrial buildings. Buildings for industrial processes. Exhibition halls. Sports facilities. Buildings for heavy industry.

OTHER INDUSTRIAL AND/OR SPECIAL CONSTRUCTIONS. Open material parks. Poles and power transmission towers. Communication towers. Headframes and extraction towers. Sheds for platforms, stations and storage areas.
STRUCTURES FOR GENERAL BUILDING. Static composition of structures. One-way floor slabs and continuous beams. Hyperstatic composition. Waffle slabs. Mixed structures. Singular buildings.
DESCRIPTION OF COMPLEMENTARY INSTALLATIONS. Ventilation. Illumination. Heating. Means of transport.
NOTIONS ON MEASUREMENTS AND BUDGETS. Measurements. Unit prices. Budgets. Certifications.
Group work, documentary compilation associated with construction, structural calculation systems and analysis of constructions in the construction and/or completed phase.
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment assignments must be submitted via the platform by a deadline two weeks before the written test in the ordinary call. The grades for these assignments will be kept for the resit exam (written test), with the possibility of reviewing and improving them by submitting them on the same day as the exam. Approved parts or assignments will not be carried over to the following year. Failure to submit any of the three assignments will result in a "No Presentado" (No Show) grade.
